description: Réseau d'assainissement des eaux - Ouvrage de rétention is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Cette couche contient autant les ouvrages stockant des eaux pluviales ou usées. Un bassin de rétention d'eaux pluviales a pour but d'écrêter les débits entrant dans celui-ci, soit en vue d'une protection hydraulique du réseau situé en aval, soit en vue d'une protection du milieu récepteur contre les effets néfastes de déversements d'eaux pluviales urbaines ... Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
